history.content: Hi, my phone suddenly lost all signal. I can't make calls, send picture messages, or get online—it's just completely dead. It was working fine before.
I can help you troubleshoot this issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth?
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line is currently suspended, which is why you have no signal and cannot make calls, send messages, or use data. The suspension is due to an overdue bill of $65.00 from your January billing cycle.

Would you like me to send you a payment request for this overdue bill so you can pay it and restore your service?
Yes, please send me the payment request so I can pay the overdue bill and get my service restored.

A payment request for your overdue bill of $65.00 has been sent. Please check your payment requests and complete the payment.

Once you have paid, let me know so I can verify your payment and help restore your service.

history.content: I've already rebooted my phone, but there's still no signal. The status bar still shows no service.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active and you’ve already rebooted your phone, let’s continue troubleshooting your device to restore your signal.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon (✈️)
- SIM card error or missing SIM message
- Any signal bars at all (even if low)
- Any other unusual icons

If you’re able, please describe exactly what you see in the status bar at the top of your phone’s screen. This will help me guide you through the next steps.
I checked the status bar and it shows excellent signal, 5G, data enabled, and connected to Chestnut-5G. What should I try next?

Thank you for the details. Since your status bar shows excellent signal, 5G, and data enabled, your phone appears to be connected to the network. However, you mentioned you still cannot make calls, send picture messages, or get online.

Let’s check if your phone is actually able to use mobile data and make calls. Please try the following:

1. Try making a regular phone call to any number. Does it go through, or do you get an error?
2. Try turning off Wi-Fi temporarily and see if you can browse the internet using mobile data only.
3. If you get any error messages, please let me know what they say.

This will help determine if the issue is with calls, data, or both. Let me know what happens when you try these steps.
I tried making a regular phone call and it went through without any issues. I also turned off Wi-Fi and was able to browse the internet using mobile data. Everything seems to be working fine now.

That’s great to hear! It looks like your service has been fully restored and everything is working as expected now.

If you experience any further issues or have any other questions, feel free to reach out. Thank you for your patience!
